title: Your own tile (and Give, Bible, Prayer, Life Groups, Ministries, Visit us): what the tile becomes at each size
question: Each size gets a designed layout instead of being refused. Which layouts should Your own tile (and Give, Bible, Prayer, Life Groups, Ministries, Visit us) offer? Good alternatives stay selectable in the tile's settings; you pick defaults per size.

options.label: Picture above
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The picture fills the top and the words sit under it; a 1 × 1 keeps a strip of picture.
options.viewport: Your own tile (and Give, Bible, Prayer, Life Groups, Ministries, Visit us) at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.

options.label: Picture behind
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The picture fills the whole tile with the words over a shade: strongest for a campaign.
